title: Static Raised Neck Four Foot and Arched Membrane Dragon
description: One independently authored complete static fantasy dragon character. A single continuous volumetric mesh forms the long muzzle, raised broad head, high curved neck, deep torso and long laterally swept tapering tail, with integral belly and closed-mouth colour regions. Four whole stout bent limbs meet four complete thick three-claw flat feet with true intertoe clefts. Two backward-swept tapering horns and embedded lateral eyes distinguish the head. Two entire obliquely spread thick scalloped membranes and their complete leading arm/finger ridges root at the shoulders. All main sections, contours and numeric construction are newly drawn; no old bat wing, crocodilian body or ceremonial dragonboat head is imported, rescaled, extracted or reassembled. One stylized character prop, zero scenes; five opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metres, Z up, full horizontal bounds-centred four-foot ground origin. Fixed sculptural game-art pose only, not biological/species anatomy, flight, living-animal care, physical stability, fabrication or safety. Rigging, skeletal animation, motion, interactions and collision behaviour are not produced or verified; no such function is part of this static delivery.
